latest.note: Boots from USB to the installer, but the NVMe drive is never found, so the disk list is empty and the installer loops on 'no options provided'. PCIe 3 (1bd0000) fails to probe (its PHY has no init sequence on Purwa) and unwinding it drops the second NVMe regulator, which shares TLMM 18 with the real slot's. With PCIe 3, its PHY and that regulator turned off in the tree, PCIe 6a links at Gen4 x4 and the installer lists the drive.

latest.note: A monitor shows the console and installer at boot. Hot-plug not tried; the GPU firmware (gen71500_sqe.fw) isn't in the live system, so only the boot framebuffer was seen.

Five of six ports work (front USB-C, front USB-A and three rear USB-A are on the multiport controller). The rear USB-A second from the right is the only port on usb_1_ss0 (a600000), which stays deferred: its eUSB2 PHY waits for an SMB2360 repeater at SPMI SID 7 that this machine doesn't have. With smb2360_0 off and the PHY's repeater dropped, the controller probes and a keyboard in that port works (omarchy-pkgs#3070).
